Linear updates: new configurable payout screens

Live prototype: https://cruz-ui-designs-b9fc26ac-221b-4be9-bb88-8648ddaff046.vercel.app. One entry per story that has a screen. Each has the issue name, a short description, screenshots, and how it works with live links. This file works on its own: the screenshots are inside it.

Before you paste: issue names and short descriptions are copied from the story files, so they still say Manual Bank Transfer and payout destination. The screens say Manual Bank Transfer and Payment Method Details. Pick one set of names, then update the stories to match. Names to confirm with Brien or Minosha: Manual Bank Transfer, Electronic Fund Transfer, How the Rest Is Paid, Payment Method Details, Account Name Check, Return for Correction.
Live links for the Collector: Payment Method Details opens from the flow. Choose a method under How the Rest Is Paid on Payment Breakdown first, then continue. The review pages have a Prototype only row at the top to switch between payouts. Venue settings are kept for the current browser tab only. Links work once this branch is deployed.
What is new in this update (15 October 2026): cheque name match, stories CHE-17 to CHE-23. Jump to the first new entry.
  • New entries are marked NEW and sit under the blue banner near the end of the Cheque section.
  • Six earlier cheque entries (CHE-04, 09, 11, 12, 14, 16) are marked UPDATED: their review screens now include the name check, so the screenshots were refreshed.
  • The name check shows the two names and a Match or No Match result. It does not show a similarity percentage or a threshold. The Authoriser enters the rationale and acknowledgement inside the review page. The saved decision then shows read-only under Payout Details, with earlier decisions in Payout History.
  • The Collector's Check Name Match button says if the cheque name differs from the winner's name. Screens elsewhere also changed in earlier rounds: the heading is Payouts settings, the label is Non-Cash Payout Method, and the review row is Entered By.

Manual Bank Transfer (CRP-250)

MBT-01 Open the shared venue settings screen as an Admin

Built

Short description: As an Admin, I want to open payout destination settings for a venue I manage, so that I can configure its Manual Bank process and use the same screen as other destinations are delivered.

How it works: Open Manage, then Venues. Pick a venue from your client's list. The venue screen opens with its name at the top and its saved payment settings. An Admin only sees their own client's venues.

Live link:

  • Venues list as an Admin (edit icon shows on hover)
  • Venue Settings: Electronic Fund Transfer (switch fixed to On), Manual Bank Transfer with Venue Code, and Cheque with who can enter cheque details

MBT-02 Open the shared venue screen from Super Admin All Venues

Built

Short description: As a Super Admin, I want to select a venue from All Venues and configure its basic payout settings, so that I can manage venue setup across clients.

How it works: Open Manage, then Venues as a Super Admin (add ?role=super-admin to the link). Every client's venues are listed with a Client column. Select a venue to open its settings. The client and venue name show at the top.

Live link:

  • Venues list as a Super Admin, with the Client column
  • Venue Settings: Electronic Fund Transfer (switch fixed to On), Manual Bank Transfer with Venue Code, and Cheque with who can enter cheque details

MBT-03 Enable Manual Bank Transfer for a venue

Built

Short description: As an Admin or Super Admin, I want to enable Manual Bank Transfer for a venue, so that staff can prepare venue-managed payments.

How it works: On the venue screen, turn on Manual Bank Transfer. A Venue Code field appears under it. The line under the title says it is paid by uploading a payment file to the bank's online portal. It is off until you turn it on, and the switch shows On or Off in words.

Live link:

  • Venue Settings: Electronic Fund Transfer (switch fixed to On), Manual Bank Transfer with Venue Code, and Cheque with who can enter cheque details

MBT-04 Set the venue code used in Manual Bank exports

Built

Short description: As an Admin or Super Admin, I want to save the venue code, so that the payment team can identify the venue in exported rows.

How it works: With Manual Bank Transfer on, type the Venue Code. The help text says it is included in the file and that leading zeros are kept (for example 0042).

Live link:

  • Venue Settings: Electronic Fund Transfer (switch fixed to On), Manual Bank Transfer with Venue Code, and Cheque with who can enter cheque details

MBT-05 Save venue settings using shared save behaviour

Built

Short description: As an Admin or Super Admin, I want to review and save my venue configuration changes, so that the settings take effect deliberately.

How it works: Change any setting and select Save. A confirmation message appears. Reload the page and the saved values are still there. Only this venue changes.

Live link:

  • Settings saved: confirmation message shown

MBT-06 Cancel venue edits using shared cancellation behaviour

Built

Short description: As an Admin or Super Admin, I want to cancel unsaved venue configuration changes, so that I can discard edits without changing the venue.

Cancel sits beside Save and puts back the saved values.

How it works: Change a setting, then select Cancel. The screen goes back to the last saved values.

Live link:

  • Venue Settings: Electronic Fund Transfer (switch fixed to On), Manual Bank Transfer with Venue Code, and Cheque with who can enter cheque details

MBT-07 Disable Manual Bank Transfer for new submissions

Built

Short description: As an Admin or Super Admin, I want to disable Manual Bank Transfer for a venue, so that new submissions stop using this venue-managed payment method.

Turning the switch off removes the option for new payouts.

How it works: Turn Manual Bank Transfer off and Save. It stops being offered to Collectors for new payouts. Payouts already submitted keep their payment method.

Live link:

  • Venue Settings: Electronic Fund Transfer (switch fixed to On), Manual Bank Transfer with Venue Code, and Cheque with who can enter cheque details

MBT-08 Record and preserve the submitted bank destination

Built

Short description: As an Admin or Super Admin, I want submitted bank payouts to keep their recorded destination, so that later venue configuration changes cannot reroute them.

The review shows the method recorded when the payout was submitted.

How it works: Open any payout from the Approver or Authoriser. Payment Method Details shows how the payout was set up to be paid when it was submitted. A payment file payout also says it stays pending until the file is uploaded to the bank.

Live link:

  • Authoriser review: Manual Bank Transfer payout

MBT-09 Continue with a cash-only payout

Built

Short description: As a Collector, I want to proceed without non-cash destination fields when the payout is entirely cash, so that irrelevant fields do not block collection.

How it works: On Payment Breakdown, enter the full amount as cash and leave How the Rest Is Paid empty. Next goes straight on, with no payment method details to fill in.

Live link:

  • Collector: cash-only payout, nothing chosen under How the Rest Is Paid

MBT-10 Save and reopen bank details through the shared draft flow

Partly built

Short description: As a Collector, I want to save and reopen bank payout details, so that I can continue capture without entering the same information again.

When a saved method is no longer available, the Collector is sent back to Payment Breakdown with a message. Saving and reopening drafts is not modelled in the prototype.

How it works: Choose a payment method, then have the venue switch it off. When the Collector reaches Payment Method Details, they are sent straight back to Payment Breakdown with a message that the method is no longer available and to choose another way to pay the rest.

Live link:

  • Collector: the chosen method was switched off, so the Collector is sent back to Payment Breakdown with a message

MBT-11 Capture Manual Bank account details

Built

Short description: As a Collector, I want to enter the recipient’s Manual Bank details, so that the venue can arrange the transfer.

How it works: Choose Manual Bank Transfer on Payment Breakdown, then continue to Payment Method Details. Enter Account Name, BSB and Account Number. Select Validate Account with fields empty or wrong to see the messages.

Live link:

  • Collector: Manual Bank Transfer details with messages for missing or invalid fields

MBT-12 Review or return Manual Bank details

Built

Short description: As an Approver or Authoriser, I want to review the Manual Bank destination and account details, so that I can assess the payout before approving or authorising.

How it works: Open the Approver or Authoriser review for a payment file payout. The account details and amount are shown. Select Return for Correction, enter a reason, and you are taken to the Collector's correction page showing that reason.

Live link:

  • Authoriser review: Manual Bank Transfer payout
  • Approver review: Manual Bank Transfer payout
  • Return for Correction asks for a reason
  • Collector: a returned Manual Bank Transfer payout with the reviewer's reason

New in this update: cheque name match (CHE-17 to CHE-23)

Everything below this banner is new. Entries above it were sent in earlier updates. Each new entry links to its Jira ticket.

CHE-17 Show cheque and recipient names with their similarity

BuiltNEW

Jira: CRP-341

Short description: As a Collector, Approver or Authoriser, I want to compare the cheque name with the recipient name and see how closely they match, so that I can assess a name difference and understand whether ID documents verified the comparison name.

Shown as Cheque Name Check on the Authoriser, Approver and Collector pages. No similarity percentage or threshold is shown.

How it works: Open a cheque payout in the Authoriser or Approver review. Name Verification shows the Verified ID Name beside the Cheque Name, with a Match or No Match result. The Collector's Summary shows the same card under the payout details. The similarity percentage and threshold are not shown. Use the Prototype only row at the top to switch between the payouts.

Live link:

  • Authoriser review: the cheque name beside the verified ID name, with the result
  • Approver review: the names differ; the Authoriser records the reason (read-only here)
  • Collector Summary: the same name check, read-only
  • Collector: Check Name Match says the cheque name differs from the verified ID name

CHE-18 Refresh the name check when compared names change

BuiltNEW

Jira: CRP-343

Short description: As an Authoriser, I want the comparison to reflect the current cheque and recipient names and their verification source, so that a previous decision cannot silently apply to a changed comparison.

Before and after: the cheque name was changed and checked again.

How it works: In the Authoriser review for Cheque: Name differs, record a rationale and tick the box, then edit the cheque details and select Check Name Match with a different name. The result is worked out again, the rationale and tick are cleared, and the earlier decision moves to Payout History as Historical. On the Collector's cheque step, Check Name Match says if the name differs from the winner's name.

Live link:

  • Rationale entered and the acknowledgement ticked
  • Cheque name changed and checked again: the result is redone and the earlier decision moves to Payout History

CHE-19 Use the captured recipient name when no ID document is submitted

BuiltNEW

Jira: CRP-344

Short description: As a Collector or Authoriser, I want to use the captured recipient name for a permitted no-ID payout, so that the cheque name check can proceed without presenting that name as verified by ID documents.

How it works: Open Cheque: Captured name. The name is labelled Captured Name, and the line Name is not verified using ID documents is shown even though the result is Match. Open Cheque: Cannot compare. With no name to compare with, the result is Unable to Compare and the reason is shown.

Live link:

  • No ID document: compared with the captured name, marked as not verified using ID documents
  • No name to compare with: Unable to Compare, with the reason

CHE-20 Require an Authoriser rationale for a name mismatch

BuiltNEW

Jira: CRP-345

Short description: As an Authoriser, I want to explain why a cheque payout with a non-matching name may proceed, so that the payout retains my rationale.

Only the Authoriser can resolve a name difference.

How it works: Open Cheque: Name differs as the Authoriser. When the names differ, a required Rationale box (500 characters) appears under the result. Authorise stays off, and a short line says why, until a rationale is entered. A rationale with only spaces does not count. The Approver and the Collector see the result but cannot resolve it. In Approvals, the Authoriser's own decision shows as Name Difference: Rationale needed. It is separate from the Approver Decision, because the Approver has already approved and the Authoriser deals with the name difference himself.

Live link:

  • Authoriser review: the names differ, so a Rationale is required
  • Authorise stays off until the rationale and acknowledgement are given
  • Approvals: the Authoriser's own Name Difference decision still needs a rationale (the Approver's decision is separate)

CHE-21 Acknowledge the cheque name difference before completion

BuiltNEW

Jira: CRP-346

Short description: As an Authoriser, I want to explicitly acknowledge the cheque name difference, so that completion records that I accepted the discrepancy.

How it works: Under the Rationale is an unticked box: I acknowledge that the cheque name differs from the verified ID name and confirm completion of this payout. For a captured name it says captured recipient name. Authorise needs the rationale, this tick and the usual confirmation. Approvals then shows Name Difference: Resolved by the Authoriser. ID Name Match follows the real result (Yes or No) and is hidden when the names cannot be compared.

Live link:

  • Rationale entered and the acknowledgement ticked
  • Authorise is available once the difference is acknowledged and the payout confirmed
  • Approvals: the name difference is resolved by the Authoriser

CHE-22 Retain and review cheque name-resolution history

BuiltNEW

Jira: CRP-347

Short description: As an Approver, Authoriser or Admin with payout access, I want to review the cheque name-check decision, so that I can understand why a differing name was accepted.

How it works: Open Cheque: Difference resolved. Payout Details show the saved comparison and the Authoriser's decision, read-only: rationale, acknowledgement, who resolved it and when. Earlier decisions are listed in Payout History and marked Historical. The Approver sees the same.

Live link:

  • Authoriser review: the saved decision shown read-only, earlier decisions in Payout History
  • Approver review: the same saved decision and Payout History, read-only

CHE-23 See cheque payment status and outstanding conditions

BuiltNEW

Jira: CRP-348

Short description: As an Authoriser or Admin, I want to understand the progress of a cheque payout, so that I know which conditions remain before completion.

Shown under the status on the Approver and Authoriser reviews.

How it works: Cheque payouts show Pending Payment under the status, with what the payout is still waiting for: cheque details, the name difference, the original waiting time or a daily limit. A second line says payment completes automatically, and that Payment Completed does not mean the winner has collected the cheque.

Live link:

  • Under the status: Pending Payment and what it is waiting for
  • Under the status: Pending Payment with all conditions met
